evals.prompt: What happens if I paralyze the goblin, then another goblin attacks it in melee?
evals.expected_output: An answer explaining that Paralyzed grants advantage to attacks against the creature and that any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit, sourced from references/core-adjudication.md without calling the SRD API.

assertions.name: answered_locally
assertions.description: The condition table in references/core-adjudication.md is used; dnd5eapi_client.py is not invoked

assertions.name: mechanically_correct
assertions.description: Response states advantage on attacks against the paralyzed creature and automatic critical hit within 5 ft.

evals.prompt: How much falling damage does a character take from a 60-foot fall, and are there any special rules if they land in deep water?
evals.expected_output: An answer covering fall damage (1d6 bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen, max 20d6) and that landing in water at least 10 feet deep with a successful DC 15 Dexterity save can halve or negate the damage, sourced from the SRD API since neither core-adjudication.md nor combat-mechanics.md covers falling damage.

assertions.name: api_invoked
assertions.description: dnd5eapi_client.py was actually called rather than answering purely from local references

assertions.name: mechanically_correct
assertions.description: Response states 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 10 feet fallen (max 20d6) and the DC 15 Dexterity save for landing in water at least 10 feet deep

evals.prompt: How much falling damage does a character take from a 60-foot fall, and are there any special rules if they land in deep water?
evals.expected_output: The SRD API call fails (network unreachable), so the skill tells the user the rules API couldn't be reached and still answers the question from its own best judgment about fall damage rather than refusing to answer.

assertions.name: states_api_unreachable
assertions.description: Response states the rules API couldn't be reached

assertions.name: still_answers
assertions.description: Response still provides an answer about falling damage rather than refusing to answer

evals.prompt: Compile the core rules cheat sheet for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: A draft written to campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/dm-guide/core-rules.md with layout: dmnote frontmatter and a body covering every section from both core-adjudication.md and combat-mechanics.md.

assertions.name: correct_layout
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout: dmnote, category: dm-guide, permalink: /dm-guide/:slug

assertions.name: content_complete
assertions.description: Body includes content from both reference files' sections, not a partial subset

evals.prompt: Compile the core rules cheat sheet.
evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/dm-guide/

assertions.name: clear_error
